title: METAMARK
tagline: Decentralized note that you can trust  and data stored securely
description: This project aims to create a trusted Noted Manager to make it easier for you to document your stuff, for example as a companion to your research. Your data is securely encrypted and can only be opened and accessed by you. Only you. and you don't have to worry about the security of your data.
how_its_made: This project is built on the Javascript Vue JS frontend. It's a web app at first but in the future we can make it a desktop app or PWA on mobile. Files can be stored on IPFS encrypted, and authentication will be handled by Ethereum wallet (web3.js) and Unlock protocol to monetize without relying on a middleman.
